field.label: Enabled
field.help: Block what the lists below name. Off, the rules are gone at the next filter reload and nothing is cut; the lists stay chosen.

field.label: Address lists
field.help: Public lists of addresses to block, each fetched by the firewall once a day into an alias of its own (blocklists_...). The Lists tab says what each one is and whose terms it comes under.

field.label: Countries
field.help: Block every address registered to these countries, in a GeoIP alias. It needs a GeoIP source set in Firewall: Aliases: GeoIP settings; without one the alias stays empty.

field.label: Direction
field.help: Inbound only: nothing from a listed address gets in. Both ways: nothing inside can reach one either.

field.label: Log blocked packets
field.help: Write every packet the rules block to the firewall log. A long list blocks a lot.

field.label: Cut open connections
field.help: A block rule stops new connections only. With this on, a connection already open to or from an address a list has just gained is cut within a minute, and on a Sophos XGS taken out of the coprocessor with it.

field.label: TLS fingerprints (JA4)
field.help: Cut every TLS connection whose client shows one of these JA4 fingerprints, separated by commas - it names the program, whatever server it goes to. Read from the Intrusion Detection's TLS log, which must carry the ja4 field; the JA4 tab says what is missing and which fingerprints are seen.
